pages.text: Units killed by you or your army drop armor shards of their race, sometimes an ability module. Shards make a race suit, crafted like vanilla armor.$(br2)Terran: as strong as diamond.$(br)Protoss: shields that come back.$(br)Zerg: regeneration, faster on creep.
Terran armor shards in the shapes of vanilla armor: helmet 5, chestplate 8, leggings 7, boots 4. As strong as diamond, hard to knock back; its modules work in the full suit.
Protoss armor shards in the shapes of vanilla armor: helmet 5, chestplate 8, leggings 7, boots 4. As iron; the full suit gives shields of 4 hearts that come back 7 seconds after the last hit.
Zerg chitin shards in the shapes of vanilla armor: helmet 5, chestplate 8, leggings 7, boots 4. As iron; the full suit regenerates a heart every 4 seconds, four times faster on creep.
